cues: In eighteen fifty, Léon Foucault did it, with a rapidly rotating mirror.
Light travels more slowly in water than in air.
That single result ended the corpuscular theory.
And the wave picture also explains interference, diffraction and polarization, which particles never could.
Those are our next three units.
